cards.phonetic: meh eh-nah-moh-REH deh el DEHS-deh el pree-MEHR DEE-ah

cards.front: Te extraño mucho cuando estás lejos.
cards.back: I miss you a lot when you're far away.
cards.phonetic: teh ehks-TRAH-nyoh MOO-choh KWAHN-doh es-TAHS LEH-hohs

cards.back: True love exists.

cards.front: Hemos estado juntos por diez años.
cards.back: We have been together for ten years.
cards.phonetic: EH-mohs es-TAH-doh HOON-tohs por dyehs AH-nyohs

cards.front: Me alegro de que estés aquí.
cards.back: I'm glad you're here.
cards.phonetic: meh ah-LEH-groh deh keh es-TEHS ah-KEE

cards.front: Es raro que no hayan llegado todavía.
cards.back: It's strange they haven't arrived yet.
cards.phonetic: es RAH-roh keh noh AH-yahn yeh-GAH-doh toh-dah-BEE-ah

cards.front: Me molesta que siempre llegues tarde.
cards.back: It bothers me that you always arrive late.
cards.phonetic: meh moh-LEHS-tah keh SYEHM-preh YEH-gehs TAR-deh

cards.back: I'm sorry that you're sick.

cards.front: Es bueno que practiques español todos los días.
cards.back: It's good that you practice Spanish every day.
cards.phonetic: es BWEH-noh keh prahk-TEE-kehs es-pah-NYOHL TOH-dohs lohs DEE-ahs

cards.front: Pasa la pelota a tu compañero.
cards.back: Pass the ball to your teammate.
cards.phonetic: PAH-sah lah peh-LOH-tah ah too kohm-pah-NYEH-roh

cards.back: Run faster.

cards.front: El partido empieza a las dos.
cards.back: The game starts at two.
cards.phonetic: el par-TEE-doh ehm-PYEH-sah ah lahs dohs

cards.back: We scored three goals yesterday.

cards.front: Entrenamos todos los martes y jueves.
cards.back: We train every Tuesday and Thursday.
cards.phonetic: ehn-treh-NAH-mohs TOH-dohs lohs MAR-tehs ee HWEH-behs
